narrative.overview: The store reads as the downstream end of a payment pipeline at night: a service console where orders arrive, state lamps flip, and the PRISM readout tells the truth about money.
keyCharacteristics: Console windows with stamped titles, not cards with icons.
Monospace only for references, amounts, readouts, and timestamps.
Amber means act or attend; green means settled; red means fault.
Motion is a single live-dot pulse; everything else is instant.

rules.name: The Amber Rarity Rule
rules.body: Amber appears on fewer than one in ten elements per screen.

rules.name: The Flat Lamp Rule
rules.body: State dots are flat color, never glows or halos.

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: If it isn't a reference, amount, timestamp, or readout value, it isn't monospace.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; state changes, not shadows, signal interactivity.

dos: Do keep amber rare — actions and live state only.
Do set every reference, amount, and timestamp in mono with tabular numerals.
Do show the honest empty/offline state.
donts: Don't add kickers, section numbers, gradient text, or glass effects.
Don't use mono for prose, buttons, or headings.
Don't invent glow, shadows, or accent border strips.
Don't fabricate timeline events or log lines for legacy rows.
